source.title: First-level administrative divisions with ISO 3166-2 codes

note: Each country's first-level divisions as listed in Wikidata, kept where they carry an ISO 3166-2 code and aren't themselves countries or territories in the spine. Hand fixes, 1 November 2026: IN-DN removed (merged into IN-DH in 2020); Delhi (IN-DL) added; four unlabelled entries named (Calabarzon, Mimaropa, Pernambuco, Tocantins).
